messages.subject: Project Tempest — EIS/R&D points for completion
messages.plaintextBody:
Nina,

From the tax side: the Series B shares are preference shares so won't qualify for EIS for the new investors (they're not seeking it). The open HMRC enquiry into the FY2023 R&D claim should be specifically disclosed — which I see Whitfield Carter have done. No issue with proceeding to completion on that basis.

Duncan Reeves
Marlow Tax & Advisory
